messages:
Nate Sales: FYI FinCorp POC next Tue. They require EU-only data residency, BYO-KMS, and want APAC as a cold failover route only. Need presales checklist + ballpark pricing delta. Anyone free to help?

Raj Patel: @Nate Sales quick clarifying Q — BYO-KMS: are they expecting Azure KeyVault / GCP CMEK or AWS KMS? We support AWS KMS + HashiVault HSM in Private; hosted has envelope key flow. Need to know for quote.

Elena Morris: We have BYO-KMS options but constraints differ: Dedicated/Private = direct KMS calls; Hosted = wrapped-key workflow + attestation. I can share the exact matrix.

Natalie Gomez: On APAC fallback: if they want zero subprocessors outside EU we must do tenant-pin to EU nodes (no APAC compute). Tenant pinning is doable but impacts capacity and pricing.

Thomas Li: Tenant pinning + BYO-KMS usually implies reserved capacity in eu-west-1. Quick rough delta: expect ~+25% on top of hosted list price depending on throughput. Will run numbers.

Thomas Li: Quick ballpark (very rough): baseline hosted for 10k tokens/day -> $X/mo; pinned/dedicated + BYO-KMS ops -> +~$1,200/mo. Need actual workload to refine.

Nate Sales: Can you drop that calc in a quick doc? Customer expects a ballpark within 24h.

Elena Morris: I'll prep subprocessor attestation + BYO-KMS checklist. Also flag: hosted BYO requires a signed DPA + subproc list + limited SOC extract. Link to template: https://redwoodinternal.company/handbooks/presales/byo-kms-checklist

Raj Patel: Security question for engineering: Does hosted BYO require client-side key wrapping or can we call customer KMS directly? For hosted we do envelope encryption; audit logs are retained. @ops-bot can you confirm retention windows for KMS-related logs?

ops-bot: Logging retention for BYO-KMS flows on hosted is 90 days by default. Dedicated/Private retention can be configured per customer. See runbook: /runbooks/kms-ops for details.

Natalie Gomez: Legal will want a list of subprocessors + explicit egress path diagram (control plane vs compute). We need to confirm whether anything touches APAC control plane or only EU control plane with APAC cold compute.

Thomas Li: Example routing policy we usually propose for this setup:
```
{ "scope": "tenant", "pin": "eu-west-1", "failover": "apac-cold", "subprocessors": ["aws-eu-west-1", "redwood-cdn-eu"] }
```

Nate Sales: Next steps: Elena -> subproc attestation doc; Raj -> confirm BYO-KMS hosting constraints + logging; Thomas -> finalize cost delta and note reserved capacity needs; Natalie -> draft legal checklist + egress diagram. I'll update FinCorp and request the security questionnaire answers. :thumbsup:

Elena Morris: Adding one ops note — if customer wants zero APAC subprocessors at all, we need a Dedicated region-only contract + infra provisioning lead time (~6-8 wks).

Nate Sales: Good call. I'll flag timeline to FinCorp. Thanks everyone.
